kicker: I HATE TO BREAK IT TO YOU
title: 6 boring habits that fix *90%* of your problems

label: HABIT 1
head: Lift 3 to 4 times a week
sub: 45 minutes, compound lifts, add weight when it gets easy. No 2-hour sessions.

label: HABIT 2
head: Walk 8,000 to 10,000 steps
sub: Take calls on foot. Walk 10 minutes after every meal. Park far away.

label: HABIT 3
head: Get morning sunlight
sub: 10 minutes outside within an hour of waking. Before your phone, not after.

items.head: Eat mostly real food
items.sub: Barcode plus 20 ingredients? That's a sometimes food.

items.head: Limit alcohol
items.sub: Two drinks wreck your sleep, your gym day and your Sunday.

label: HABIT 6
head: Sleep like it's your job
sub: Same bedtime, dark room, phone charging outside the bedroom. 7 to 9 hours.

head: Same guy, 90 days later
l: Tired, puffy, shopping for a new supplement
r: Lean, clear-headed, sleeps through the night

text: You don't need a new hack. You need the *boring basics* every single week.
